prompt: A blinding vertical pillar of holy golden-white light, crepuscular rays, descends from a stormy grey sky onto a medieval battlefield. Beneath it, an entire army of small figures — armored knights in steel plate, a hulking horned beast, a robed wizard — are all simultaneously struck down, crumbling to ash and bone, silhouettes collapsing in every direction across the muddy field. Smoke and embers rise. The background is a wide ruined battlefield under heavy grey clouds at dawn.
